audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer called Levels 1 through 6 'Skill' while the content layer and the packet both gave those rows to Annie — five disagreeing rows rendered to the same reader.
audit.why: Annie begins the game with Pyromania available, so a stun is live at level 1 inside 625 range, and Disintegrate is a 4s cooldown that refunds its mana on a kill. Anivia has no answer to that until Glacial Storm. The content and packet reading is the correct one.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side set to Annie; early ratings dropped to 4/10 to match.
sources: enemy kit P/Q text and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer pinned Anivia's first-item spike to Rylai's, contradicting the full layer's own itemization (Lost Chapter into Rod of Ages or Seraph's).
audit.why: Anivia's spike is mana and storm uptime — Glacial Storm already chills, and the chill is what doubles Frostbite. Annie's spikes are Pyromania at level 1, and Tibbers at 6 on a 130s cooldown at rank 1.
audit.corrected: whys[5], spikes[2].text and late rewritten around the mana item and storm uptime; the 130s Tibbers cooldown written into spikes[1] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions were absent. (1) Annie's entire kit works at 600-625 while Flash Frost is 1075 — the page even claimed 'she outranges your early trades', which is backwards. (2) Molten Shield damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells, so chip poke costs you health. (3) Annie has no dash of any kind, which makes Crystallize a complete stop on her engage rather than a delay.
audit.why: Ranges from both kits: Anivia Q 1075, E 650, R 750; Annie Q 625, W 600, E 800 (shield), R 600. Annie E text: 'damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells'. No dash flag appears anywhere in Annie's kit; Anivia W flag is 'creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes'.
audit.corrected: Range reversal fixed in spikes[0], early and wants.you[0]; Molten Shield's return damage written into tradeGood, tradeBad and whys[1]; the no-dash wall interaction into breakdown.carry, dosFull[1], spikes[3] and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns told the player to 'count it out loud' without saying what to count, and framed Pyromania as a timer.
audit.why: Pyromania is not on a cooldown — it arms on her next offensive spell after four casts, so it is counted in casts. Disintegrate is 4s, Incinerate 7s, Molten Shield 10s, Tibbers 130/115/100s.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to count casts, with the real numbers for Tibbers and Disintegrate.
sources: enemy kit P text and cooldown strings

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer referred to Annie as 'he'/'his' in tldr, winCon, loading, the dos/donts titles and report[9]/report[11].
audit.why: Annie is female; the kit text uses she/her.

notes: The page's 'Flash-Tibbers' line was replaced rather than repeated: Flash-buffering is not in the kit data and the brief forbids asserting it, so the advice was rebuilt on the verifiable facts (Tibbers is a 600-range cast, Pyromania arms after four casts). The claim 'she outranges your early trades' was flatly backwards — Annie's longest offensive range is 625 against Flash Frost's 1075 — and was corrected. Tibbers' own behaviour once summoned (leash range, whether he re-targets, whether Crystallize blocks him) is not in the kit text and was not asserted beyond 'he walks'.
